name: x
description: A solid rounded square with a centered close cutout and two-unit clearance.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner clarified that X Outline and the negative-space X in Filled must share the same position, dimensions, stroke weight and rounded tips, exactly like Plus. Both glyphs use diagonal centerline endpoints 2.85..21.15 on each axis, Regular-equivalent width 1.70 and .85 round caps. The visible glyph bounds are 2..22 on the native 24 by 24 grid. The Filled cutout is the exact analytical union of the Outline stroke exterior. Its upright solid rounded box extends another 2 units around the glyph, giving box bounds 0..24 and radius-2.85 corners. The 2px artboard margin refers to the shared glyph; the surrounding Filled box reaches the artboard edges. Both styles are centered at 12,12, with no style-specific glyph scaling or translation. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
